title: Turtle Scutes Fall Off│龜甲脫落
description: Turtles occasionally drop Turtle Scutes, not just when they grow to adulthood.│海龜偶爾會脫落龜甲，而不僅在它們成年時。
body:
# Function│功能
- Every 10-15 minutes, adult Turtles will drop a Turtle Scale.│每10-15分鐘，成年海龜會掉落一個海龜鱗甲。
- Every 3-5 minutes, baby Turtles will drop a Turtle Scale.│每3-5分鐘，幼年海龜會掉落一個海龜鱗甲。
- When a baby Turtle grows into an adult, the countdown for it to shed Turtle Scales resets.│當幼年海龜成長為成年海龜，海龜鱗甲脫落的倒計時會重置。
